A day in the park

How a Nairobi National Park morning actually runs

Nairobi National Park rewards an early start, because the plains game moves at dawn and the park sits on the traffic-heavy southern side of the city. Here is the shape of a typical morning.

  1. Before dawn

    01Pick-up at your door

    Your guide arrives at your hotel, apartment or airport terminal at the time agreed by email, so nobody is negotiating with taxis in the dark.

  2. First light

    02Through the gate

    Reaching the gate near opening puts you on the plains while predators are still moving, which is when lion, cheetah and rhino sightings are most likely.

  3. Mid morning

    03Coffee on the plains

    A pause at a viewpoint over the Athi plains or the Mokoyeti gorge, with the skyline behind you and the herds in front.

  4. Midday

    04City attractions or the road home

    Half-day guests are back for lunch. Full-day guests continue to the elephant orphanage, the Giraffe Centre and Karen, or press on to the Rift Valley.

  5. Read the full planning guide

Why book direct

You are booking the operator, not a listing

Nairobi Adventures answers its own email, plans its own routes and drives its own days, so the person who confirms your booking is the person who knows what the road and the weather are doing that week.

One day, planned around your flight

Layover and last-day guests get a route timed backwards from airport check-in, so the schedule protects the flight first and the sightseeing second.

Prices published, fees inside them

Every tour page shows the price per person by group size with park and attraction entry already included, because a headline figure that excludes the gate fee is not a price, it is a deposit on a surprise.

Nairobi knowledge, not a script

Routes change with the rains, the road works and where the lions were seen yesterday, so your guide adjusts on the morning rather than repeating a fixed loop.

Straight answers before you pay

Ask what you can realistically see in four hours and you get a realistic answer, because an oversold day costs us the review that brings the next guest.

Common questions

Asked before nearly every booking

If your question is not here, send it to us and we answer it directly rather than pointing you at a brochure.

More practical detail
Can you really see lions and rhinos within sight of Nairobi city?+
Yes. Nairobi National Park sits directly on the southern edge of the city, so lion, black rhino, buffalo, giraffe, zebra and eland graze on open plains with office towers on the horizon. The park has no elephants, because the fenced northern boundary and its size suit plains game rather than large elephant herds.
How early do Nairobi National Park game drives start?+
Early, because wildlife is most active in the cool hours after dawn and Nairobi traffic thickens through the morning. An early pick-up puts your vehicle at the gate close to opening, which is why first-light departures see far more than late-morning ones. Tell us your hotel and we confirm an exact pick-up time.
Are park entry fees included in the price?+
Yes. Every price on this site includes the entry fees for that day, so the Kenya Wildlife Service conservation fee of USD 80 per person for Nairobi National Park is already inside the figure you see. The published prices use non-resident rates, and Kenyan citizens and East African residents pay less, so tell us if that applies and we requote.
Do you pick up from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport?+
Yes. Pick-up from JKIA, Wilson Airport, Nairobi hotels and private apartments is standard on every excursion, and layover guests are collected at the terminal and returned there with time to spare before check-in.
What should I bring on a day tour?+
Bring a warm layer for the early start, sunscreen and a hat for midday, binoculars if you own a pair, a camera with a zoom lens, and cash or a card for entry fees and lunch. Nairobi sits at roughly 1,795 metres, so mornings are genuinely cold before the sun climbs.

Tell us the day you have free

Send your dates, your Nairobi address and the number of travellers. We reply within one working day with availability, the confirmed price for your group and a suggested route for that day.
